C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 180
Date 21/3/16

Municipal Police.
Criminal Investigation Dept:
Captain Superintendent's Office.

Shanghai, 20th March 1916.

Sir,
General Yang received a telegram from Peking at 3 p.m.
18th instant officially notifying him that Kwangse
had declared independence. The same telegram stated
that the Central Government has had no report from
Chiangchun Taung 湯 of Hunan and Chiangchun Yang 楊
of Sinkiang 新疆 for the past four days.
It is reported that the situation in Peking is
very critical and that officials are deserting their
posts daily.
General Yang entertained General Tsang Tsung Sung
whose arrival from Peking was reported on 18th inst and
Deputy Military Governor Lui to tiffin in the Arsenal
on the same day. During the meal General Yang spoke of
the trying times through which the country is passing
at present. He said he had been specially sent by Yuan
Shih Kai to exhort the Shanghai officials to act in
concord, and patriotically assist in saving their
country from the dangers with which it is threatened.
The man, whose arrest near the Arsenal with a map
in his possession was reported on 18th instant is a
native of Kiangsi named Nyeu Wen Tsang 廖文蒼. He
returned a week ago to this country from Japan where he
had been a student for about three years.
Extraordinary precautions are still being taken
in the City and Chapei.
It is reported that General Yang has received
special instructions from Chiangchun Feng to watch
boats arriving from Japan, as he has received information
that they are bringing revolutionaries, guns and
munitions from the country named to China.
It is reported that Wu Ting Fang 伍廷芳 has received
a telegram from America saying that he will be killed
if he does not publicly contradict the report that he
and Tong Shao Yi had promised to assist Yuan Shih Kai
in conciliating the Yunnan rebels.

Your Obedient Servant,
McLaughlin
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered _______ March 20.

刑事调查处
情报官登记簿
第 180 号
日期 16年3月21日

公共租界警务处。
刑事调查处：
总巡官办公室。

上海，1916年3月20日。

先生：

杨将军于本月18日下午3时收到来自北京的电报，正式通知他广西已宣布独立。同一份电报还称，中央政府已有四天未收到湖南督军汤芗铭和新疆督军杨增新的报告。

据报道，北京局势非常危急，官员们每日都在弃职逃离。

杨将军宴请了曾宗松将军（据报曾将军于本月18日自北京抵达）以及副军事长官刘氏，同日中午在兵工厂共进午餐。席间，杨将军谈到了国家目前所经历的艰难时局。他表示，自己是受袁世凯特别派遣，来劝勉上海官员同心协力，以爱国精神协助国家摆脱面临的危险。

本月18日报称在兵工厂附近被捕且身上藏有地图的那名男子，是江西籍人士，名为廖文苍。他一周前从日本返回本国，此前他在日本留学约三年。

市区和闸北仍在采取特别的防范措施。

据报道，杨将军已收到冯国璋督军的特别指令，要求监视从日本驶来的船只，因为他收到情报称，这些船只正从该国向我国运送革命党人、枪支和弹药。

据报道，伍廷芳收到来自美国的电报，称如果他不公开驳斥有关他与唐绍仪曾承诺协助袁世凯安抚云南叛军的报道，他将被杀害。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克劳林
首席探长

警务处总巡官。

录入 _______ 3月20日。
